ask-llm.label: whotoask ask --mode llm
ask-llm.note: Recorded on a laptop running a local model (llama3.2 via Ollama), against this same simulated company. It is recorded rather than live because a model ordering the matches on a small server without a graphics card takes the better part of a minute, and this public demo runs no model at all. The rows are the recorded order, shown in the current output layout. Compare it with the keyword answer beside it: the same person comes first either way. The model does not find anyone. It only sets the order of the people the index already matched, and the recommendation line is written locally from that order, so it can only name someone the index found.
ask-llm.text:
$ whotoask ask --mode llm "kafka consumer lag keeps climbing, who can help"
